delivered.body: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures. 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential information. The receiving party shall protect disclosed information for a period of three years from the date of disclosure or until the information is no longer confidential, whichever is later. 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. Breach may be enjoined, and in addition to damages, the injured party may seek specific performance or other equitable relief as warranted.

delivered.body: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures. 2. DEFINITION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. For purposes of this Agreement, 'confidential information' shall include all written, electronic, or oral information disclosed by either party, including but not limited to documents, data, business plans, and discussions that are marked or identified as confidential or that a reasonable person would consider confidential given the nature of the information and the circumstances of disclosure. The receiving party shall protect disclosed information for a period of three years from the date of disclosure or until the information is no longer confidential, whichever is later. 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. Breach may be enjoined, and in addition to damages, the injured party may seek specific performance or other equitable relief as warranted.
